name: WTI Crude Oil Fundamental Drivers
description: Research study analyzing the fundamental drivers behind WTI crude oil price movements. Pillar 1 examines US inventory trends (total crude stocks, Cushing hub stocks, YoY inventory change, field production) using EIA weekly data from FRED. Pillar 2 assesses macro sentiment via WTI-USD rolling correlation. All weekly/monthly economic data is forward-filled to daily frequency and aligned to the CL-Futures bar index.
source:
# WTI Crude Oil — Fundamental Drivers Analysis
# Pillar 1: US Inventory Trends (EIA weekly data via FRED)
# Pillar 2: Macro Sentiment (WTI vs USD correlation)

# ============================================================================
# DATA SOURCES
# ============================================================================

# CL-Futures: WTI crude oil continuous front contract
src = market_data_source()()
cont = futures_continuation(s_rollover_method=RolloverType.FirstOfMonth, s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.BackwardPanamaCanal)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)
wti_close = cont.c

# Bar timestamps for X-axis of xy_lines
ts = index()

# --- EIA Weekly Inventory Data (forward-filled to daily) ---
# WCRSTUS1: US Ending Stocks of Crude Oil (thousand barrels)
inv_raw = economic_indicators(series_id='WCRSTUS1', use_alfred=False)()
inventory = ffill(inv_raw.result)

# WCESTUS1: Cushing OK Ending Stocks (thousand barrels)
cushing_raw = economic_indicators(series_id='WCESTUS1', use_alfred=False)()
cushing = ffill(cushing_raw.result)

# WCRFPUS2: US Crude Oil Field Production (thousand barrels/day)
prod_raw = economic_indicators(series_id='WCRFPUS2', use_alfred=False)()
production = ffill(prod_raw.result)

# --- Year-over-Year Inventory Change ---
# 52 weeks = ~260 trading days on daily bars (5 days/week)
inventory_yoy = inventory - (inventory >> 260)

# --- Macro Data ---
# DCOILWTICO: Daily WTI spot price from FRED (cross-check)
wti_spot_raw = economic_indicators(series_id='DCOILWTICO', use_alfred=False)()
wti_spot = ffill(wti_spot_raw.result)

# DTWEXBGS: Nominal Broad US Dollar Index (daily)
usd_raw = economic_indicators(series_id='DTWEXBGS', use_alfred=False)()
usd_index = ffill(usd_raw.result)

# --- Returns for Correlation ---
wti_ret = returns(period=1, type=ReturnsType.simple)(wti_close)
usd_ret = returns(period=1, type=ReturnsType.simple)(usd_index)

# Rolling 60-day correlation: WTI returns vs USD returns
corr_wti_usd = rolling_corr(window=60, window_type=WindowType.rolling, method=CorrelationMethod.pearson)(x=wti_ret, y=usd_ret)

# ============================================================================
# PILLAR 1 — US INVENTORY TRENDS
# ============================================================================

# Chart 1: WTI Price + US Crude Inventory (dual-axis concept via overlay)
xy_lines(
    title='WTI Price vs US Crude Inventory',
    category='1. US Inventory Trends',
    y_axis_label='WTI Price ($)',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='WTI Close', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='US Crude Inventory (k bbl)', color=Color.Orange, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=1
)(x_values=ts, y_values=(wti_close, inventory))

# Chart 2: Cushing OK Stocks
xy_lines(
    title='Cushing OK Crude Oil Stocks',
    category='1. US Inventory Trends',
    y_axis_label='Thousand Barrels',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Cushing Stocks', color=Color.Indigo)
    ]),
    order=2
)(x_values=ts, y_values=cushing)

# Chart 3: YoY Inventory Change (area fill, zero reference line)
xy_lines(
    title='US Crude Inventory — Year-over-Year Change',
    category='2. Inventory YoY & Production',
    y_axis_label='Thousand Barrels (YoY Δ)',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat,
    area=True,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='YoY Inventory Change', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, title='Zero', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=1
)(x_values=ts, y_values=inventory_yoy)

# Chart 4: US Crude Production
xy_lines(
    title='US Crude Oil Field Production',
    category='2. Inventory YoY & Production',
    y_axis_label='Thousand Barrels/Day',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='US Production', color=Color.Teal)
    ]),
    order=2
)(x_values=ts, y_values=production)

# ============================================================================
# PILLAR 2 — MACRO SENTIMENT
# ============================================================================

# Chart 5: Rolling 60-day WTI vs USD Correlation
xy_lines(
    title='WTI vs USD — Rolling 60-Day Correlation',
    category='3. Macro Sentiment',
    y_axis_label='Correlation',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='WTI-USD Corr (60d)', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, title='Zero', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash),
        ReferenceLine(value=-0.5, title='Strong Negative', color=Color.Red, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot)
    ]),
    order=1
)(x_values=ts, y_values=corr_wti_usd)

# ============================================================================
# SUMMARY TABLE — Key Fundamental Snapshot
# ============================================================================

summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='WTI Fundamental Snapshot',
        row_size=3,
        col_size=2,
        row_headers=['Inventory (k bbl)', 'Cushing Stocks (k bbl)', 'US Production (k bbl/d)'],
        col_headers=['Current', '1Y Ago'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=0, title='Current Inventory'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=0, title='1Y Ago Inventory'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=0, title='Current Cushing'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=0, title='1Y Ago Cushing'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=0, title='Current Production'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=0, title='1Y Ago Production')
        ]
    ),
    category='4. Snapshot',
    order=1
)(inventory, inventory >> 260, cushing, cushing >> 260, production, production >> 260)

summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='WTI Price & Correlation',
        row_size=2,
        col_size=2,
        row_headers=['WTI Futures Price', 'WTI-USD Correlation (60d)'],
        col_headers=['Current', 'YoY Inv Change (k bbl)'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat, dp=2, title='WTI Price'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=0, title='YoY Inv Change'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3, title='WTI-USD Corr'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2, title='USD Index')
        ]
    ),
    category='4. Snapshot',
    order=2
)(wti_close, inventory_yoy, corr_wti_usd, usd_index)
